title: Letter and Harbor
author: Kestrel Thackeray
blurb: Emrys Thackeray, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
